title: Quentin and the Thorn
author: Sebastian Yarrow
blurb: Edmund Halloran, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
